onFaint.line: YOU COME ROUND BY THE BRAZIER, BROTHER ANSELM POURING TEA. "A YETI CARRIED YOU TO THE GATE AND KNOCKED. VERY POLITELY. WATCH THE SNOW, I SAID. IT TELLS YOU WHERE IT RISES."

interactions.label: THE SHRINE
interactions.dialog: A CHORTEN ON A LEDGE OF ROCK, PRAYER FLAGS RAGGED IN THE WIND, AND HEAPED ROUND IT A THOUSAND YEARS OF OFFERINGS TO WHATEVER SWIMS UNDER THE SNOW: BUTTER LAMPS, COINS, BONES, A CHILD'S WOODEN HORSE. SOMEBODY CARVED ON THE ROCK: "LET IT SLEEP."

interactions.label: RIBS
interactions.dialog: RIBS AS TALL AS A HOUSE, SMOOTH AS OLD IVORY, STICKING UP OUT OF THE SNOW LIKE THE FRAME OF A BOAT. WHATEVER THIS WAS, SOMETHING BIGGER ATE IT.
